bridgeRouteRisk.summary: PYUSD has four issuer-backed native deployments on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana, and Stellar. All other authored EVM/Tron expansion is PYUSD0 omnichain representation minted by Stargate Hydra (LayerZero) adapters or NativeOFT machinery. The canonical Ethereum OFTWrapper's bridge mint/burn, owner, peer, and rate-limit powers are assessed as a separate Bridge Risk control, while native issuer controls remain in Mint Authority. Because the extended route surface includes external interoperability validation, Pharos scores the multichain route as external validated network risk.

routes.reviewNote: Ethereum is a reviewed native Paxos issuance route. Its canonical-side LayerZero OFTWrapper ingress/egress and owner-controlled bridge machinery are represented by bridgeRouteRisk.controls[0]; the wrapper is not counted as native Mint Authority.

routes.reviewNote: Re-verified 2026-09-01 at Koios tip block 13883854. Koios asset_info for policy 25c5de5f5b286073c593edfd77b48abc7a48e5a4f3d4cd9d428ff935 asset name 5059555344 returns PYUSD (fingerprint asset1mugant52ue7kdzlh5nfv789rny8dffjnfgue26), total_supply 199,288,953 units at 6 decimals, mint_cnt 7 and burn_cnt 4, first minted 2024-12-11, carrying Cardano mint metadata label 1 {type 9, tokenPairID 898} written by the Wanchain bridge; the Cardano token registry subject 25c5de5f...5059555344 describes it as 'The Mapping token of PYUSD by WanChain' and points at wanscan.org/tokens. Controller identity is authored by the adopted controller-identity convention (agents/open-data-resolver/decisions/A1-controller-identity-convention.md, rule A1-4), not by a new controller-specific read: on Cardano the controller of record is the 28-byte minting policy ID and never the full asset id used by id/contractAddress, following the reviewed dai-makerdao route cardano:25c5de5f5b286073c593edfd77b48abc7a48e5a4f3d4cd9d428ff935444149, which publishes this same policy hash as its controllerAddress. The prior reviewer's objection is answered rather than overridden: the rotating 25-node Wanchain Storeman group (MPC plus Shamir secret sharing, more than two-thirds of nodes required to sign; smgID 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000041726965735f303638 when last polled 2026-07-22) is the human authority behind that policy and is recorded in this note and in failureDomainKeys as protocol:wanchain-bridge, because the schema's controllerAddress can hold only a single on-chain identity. Wanchain's live tokenPairs API listed no Cardano-chain pairs at all on 2026-09-01 (448 pairs, no ADA chain type): pair 898 here, 894 for EURC and 563 for the already-reviewed dai-makerdao route are all absent, so pair absence is a property of the whole Wanchain Cardano lane rather than evidence against this route, and it bears on whether new mints are currently offered, not on the identity of the policy controlling the outstanding representation.

routeChecks.pausersAdminsUpgraders: At Ethereum block 25770456, owner() on the verified OFTWrapper returned Paxos EOA 0x3af3e85f4f97de7ad0f000b724fb77fe5ffc024b. The wrapper is bridge machinery; its SupplyControl mint permission is canonical-side ingress/egress accounting and is not native Mint Authority.

controls.evidence: The verified Ethereum OFTWrapper at 0xa2c323fe5a74adffad2bf3e007e36bb029606444 is a LayerZero OFT Adapter, not a generic Paxos issuer controller. Its ABI exposes bridge send/receive, peer, delegate, enforced-option, pre-crime/message-inspector, and rate-limit functions. At block 25770456 its owner was the Paxos EOA 0x3af3e85f4f97de7ad0f000b724fb77fe5ffc024b; at block 25711753 SupplyControl listed it as an active controller with the dated 560,000,000 rolling capacity and 6,482 PYUSD-per-second refill. This adverse bridge mint/burn and administrator exposure remains scoreable here while the same EOA's separately evidenced native controller-manager powers remain in Mint Authority.
